title: Crash when importing GLB file with image texture in compatibility mode
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]
- Reproducible in v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 7600S (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.22029.1019) - AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 15.24 GiB memory

### Issue description

When importing a GLB file with an image texture, the editor will crash if the project is in compatibility mode. The project can sometimes be started up again but can other times be stuck in an infinite import into crash loop until the model is removed

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new general file in Blender
- Create a material with an Image Texture
- Export the model as a GLB File and import in a project in compatibility mode

The MRP can crash by taking out the model and the texture from the project, deleting the .godot folder and moving the files back into the project
